notes: 'cannot' fuses לֹא and יוּכְלוּ because one English word carries both the negation and the ability (rule 30); splitting it is impossible without dividing the word.
The resultative לְ before חֶרְפָּה is unrepresented because הָיָה itself carries 'is become' (rule 21), while the dative לָהֶם keeps 'unto'.
